subject: Short pilot bridge: burst hours addendum and invoicing options
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena@proofpoint.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short pilot bridge: burst hours addendum and invoicing options

Hi Lena —

Quick note following up from our call this morning. The Proofpoint engineering team expects a short spike in inference usage for the next 10 days as they validate end-to-end latency under production-like load. We can accommodate a short bridge to avoid throttling the mini-POC, but need to lock the commercial path quickly so procurement can issue a PO.

Two options we can offer:
- Invoice addendum (preferred by procurement): Redwood issues a one-time invoice for a burst block of hours, billed net 30.
- Credit top-up: add flexible credits to your account now; credits consumed over the POC.

Numbers we discussed on the call (engineer estimate):
- Expected incremental GPU hours: ~220 hours over 10 days
- Normal POC rate: $18 / GPU-hour

We can provide a one-time bridge price at either:
A) Invoice addendum: 20% off list for this block => $14.40 / GPU-hour => ~ $3,168 before tax (invoice)
B) Credit top-up: standard list ($18) but immediate credit balance; we can offer a $300 credit bonus if you prepay for the block via credits.

Attachments: pilot_usage_report.csv (current burn + forecast).

Ask: Which path will procurement prefer (invoice PO vs prepay credit)? If invoice, I can share an invoice preview and a one-page MOU for signature. If credit, procurement can still route a PO for prepayment to speed things up.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Lena Brooks <lena@proofpoint.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Proofpoint Procurement <procurement@proofpoint.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot bridge: burst hours addendum and invoicing options

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the clear options. Procurement wants an invoice they can attach to the PO (we have to run this through our AP workflow). Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you provide an invoice preview with line items and total (including the 20% discount) so our buyer can attach it to the PO?
2) We need a short SOW/MOU that notes the bridge is for the mini-POC only (10-day burst) and that unused hours will not be refunded but can be converted to credits at Proofpoint's request within 30 days.

If you can get those two docs today, procurement will target issuing a PO by EOD Friday. Legal may glance at the MOU but it will be quick.

—Lena
Lena Brooks
Director, Applied ML — Proofpoint
lena@proofpoint.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Pricing suggestion for Proofpoint bridge

Internal —

Following Mateo's note and Lena's ask: finance has given room for a one-time bridge concession for strategic mini-POCs. I recommend we present the invoice addendum path with these terms:
- Block: 225 GPU-hours at discounted unit rate $14.40 (20% off) => $3,240 subtotal
- Option to convert up to 25 unused hours to credits within 30 days (no cash refunds)
- Net 30 invoice, Redwood standard T&Cs; attach one-page MOU stating scope (10-day burst) and that the bridge ends when block exhausted or 10 days elapsed.

I drafted an invoice preview (invoice_preview.xlsx) and a one-page MOU stub (mini-poc-mou-draft.pdf). If we go this route we should:
- Lock pricing with Karthik/Finance sign-off
- Share invoice + MOU with Proofpoint procurement and request PO by Fri EOD

Marissa — can you confirm the billing code we should use (SaaS-Burst-2026) and whether we need to raise a special revenue recognition note?

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Pricing suggestion for Proofpoint bridge

Vanessa / Mateo —

Finance approves the 20% one-time concession for the 225-hour block provided:
- We capture the PO and invoice within the current fiscal month (recognition controls)
- The MOU explicitly states 'one-time bridge for mini-POC; non-recurring discount'

Revenue ops note: label as 'Promo-Bridge-2026-Q3' and route invoice through contract #RDW-2026-331. Marissa — please confirm billing code and we'll finalize the invoice preview.

Karthik

Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot bridge: burst hours addendum and invoicing options

Lena / procurement team —

Thanks — we can proceed with the invoice addendum approach. Attached: invoice_preview.xlsx and mini-poc-mou-draft.pdf (one-pager). Summary:
- Line item: 225 GPU-hours (bridge block) at $14.40 / hr (20% discount) = $3,240 + applicable tax
- Payment terms: Net 30; Redwood legal will treat this as an addendum to the existing trial engagement (no change to core trial terms)
- Unused hours: up to 25 can be converted to credits on request within 30 days; any additional unused hours are forfeited

Next steps:
1) Procurement to issue PO (attach invoice preview) — target EOD Friday, Sep 3
2) Proofpoint legal to sign the one-page MOU (we can accept emailed approval for this short addendum)
3) Redwood to send invoice once PO is in place; hours will be credited to your account on payment receipt

If procurement needs a slightly different billing descriptor, let us know and we'll adjust the invoice. Happy to take a 10-min sync tomorrow if you want to walk through the invoice fields.

—Mateo
